1879094942.name: Gift of the Hammerhand
1879094942.desc: Grants a Morale bubble to a Fellowship member.\n\nBubble strength is 20% of the target's Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879115294.name: Archer's Strike
1879115294.desc: This shot can only be used against those that are enemies of the Elves, who will take devastating damage.  It will never miss against on-level creatures.  On a critical hit, the target will take power damage as well.\n\nElven Enemy required to use this skill.

1879146910.name: Muster in the Twenty-first Hall
1879146910.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Twenty-first Hall in Moria.

1879209886.name: Steed of the Hunter
1879209886.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the hunter.

1879216158.name: Improved Punctured Target
1879216158.desc: A sharpened arrow that can pierce armour.  On hit, reduces the active cooldown of Vital Target.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Ignores 30% of your target's mitigations</rgb>

1879231262.name: Shield and Shield
1879231262.desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879232414.name: Javelin of Virtue
1879232414.desc: A forward thrust which deals strong Light Damage over time.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879241630.name: Call of the Eorlingas
1879241630.desc: Your Call unleashes a fearsome assault on a target and enemies near the target.

1879266846.name: Quick Stab
1879266846.desc: The Dúnedain have trained at quickly striking their foes with a blade.

1879311262.name: Cleanse
1879311262.desc: Your experience in the woods has taught you how to deal with evils that plague your allies.

1879354910.name: Guide to the Udûn Foothold
1879354910.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the Udûn Foothold.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879391390.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Elvish Hunter)
1879391390.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879406750.name: White Carrying Chicken
1879406750.desc: Carry around your prized white chicken.

1879411742.name: Wild Grey Donkey
1879411742.desc: Summons a loveable wild donkey travelling companion.

1879416222.name: Ashen Eagle
1879416222.desc: Summons an eagle to keep you company.

1879427870.name: Backhand Slash
1879427870.desc: Glúrkub's backhand slash often catches his enemies by surprise.

1879457566.name: Desperate Combat
1879457566.desc:
In desperate situations, a warden is capable of striking at many opponents before them.

When activated, this skill will enable Desperate Spear, Desperate Shield, or Desperate Fist for 90s, depending on the type of gambit you last used.

This skill will consume all of your Advanced Technique, giving you an additional use of Desperate Spear, Shield, or Fist for each Advanced Technique consumed.

1879458718.name: Gift of Spirit
1879458718.desc: Instantly restores a large amount of morale to you or an ally.\n\nThis skill consumes the Inspirited buff when used.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879459102.name: Furious Strikes
1879459102.desc: Your Herald can increase their offence for a short time.

1879466270.name: Sail to Lothlórien
1879466270.desc: Navigate to Lothlórien with nearby fellows.

1879467294.name: Rummage: Salts
1879467294.desc: A small phial of mysterious salts from distant shores.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879467806.name: Blood Prize
1879467806.desc: Entering a frenzied state, you do increased Bleed and Wrath Builder Damage for a duration.\n\nBuilders include Slash, Slam, Biting Edge, Serrated Edge, Thrash and Expose.

1879488030.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Savannah Pride-keeper)
1879488030.desc: Summons a big cat companion.\n\nThe cat is capable of attacking multiple foes at once.

1879490718.name: Shadow Raven
1879490718.desc: Summons a shadowy raven to accompany you on your travels.

1879491486.name: Guide to Jirush
1879491486.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Jirush in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879498142.name: Herding Dog of the Rohirrim
1879498142.desc: Summons a hard-working dog to accompany you on your travels.

1879501342.name: Sail to Utug-bûr
1879501342.desc: Navigate to the Temple of Utug-bûr, in the far reaches of Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley with nearby fellows.

1879508254.name: Even the Odds
1879508254.desc: Roll the dice for a little extra, gaining one of four temporary boons.

1879517982.name: Spirit
1879517982.desc: Call upon the stallion's spirit to restore the Power of your fellows.

1879522078.name: Plant a Patch of: Crystals
1879522078.desc: Plant some seeds and make a lovely patch of crystal?
